raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Part **3/n** of the Kimi K3 / Dist-MoE training stack. Based on `main`: the review diff contains only this feature.

## Why

Whole-model CPU offload is too coarse when only a few transformer blocks exceed the memory budget. Selecting layer FQNs must affect both FSDP wrapping and local parameter materialization; otherwise wrapping and initialization disagree. MTP decoder paths also need the same policy.

Example:

```python
ParallelismConfig(
    fsdp_cpu_offload_layer_fqns=("layers.7", "layers.15"),
)
# These block units use CPU offload.
# Other parameter units and model buffers retain their usual placement.
```

## What changed

- Validate selected block FQNs and reject simultaneous selected-layer and whole-model offload.
- Forward the selected policy through common decoder, DeepSeek MTP, and fault-tolerant initialization paths.
- Initialize selected local shards on CPU while keeping model buffers device-resident.
- Add regression coverage for all MTP policy-forwarding call sites.

## Alternatives considered

Moving completed modules to CPU after construction can materialize full parameters first and miss FSDP's offload contract. Offloading the entire model needlessly affects otherwise memory-safe units.

## User-facing changes

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| Only whole-model offload is configurable, and model materialization has no selected-layer contract. | Recipes may offload explicit transformer-block FSDP units; empty selection preserves existing behavior. |

## Numerics

Parameter/offload ownership changes, not the layer computation or HF checkpoint mapping. Fresh distributed offload loss/gradient parity remains a landing gate.

## Testing

Fresh validation after rebasing on upstream `0f34815372413b72279080191978bb55a45c9ee7`:

- **78 CPU checks passed** for configuration, MTP forwarding, trainer initialization, and graph-trainer forwarding.
- **2 focused execution tests passed on GPU 0**, covering selected decoder offload and CPU-offloaded DTensor initialization. These are execution, not collection results.
- All non-type-checking pre-commit hooks passed. The one type error at unchanged `torchtitan/components/data/multimodal/utils/video.py:114` independently reproduces on untouched upstream `0f34815372413b72279080191978bb55a45c9ee7`; this PR does not change that file.

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' python -m pytest -q -o addopts='' -p no:cacheprovider --tb=short \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/config/test_config_validation.py \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/distributed/test_mtp_fsdp_cpu_offload.py \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/models/deepseek_v4/test_deepseek_v4_mtp.py \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_trainer.py \
  torchtitan/experiments/graph_trainer/tests/test_trainer_cpu_offload_config.py
```

Not verified in this fresh review: distributed offload loss/gradient and CUDA-graph replay parity. The two full-scale recipes do not enable selected-layer offload; this remains an independent option, not their memory-safety requirement.

## Stack

Based on `main` after merged 1/n and removal of 2/n. Next: [#5677](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5677).

<details>
<summary>Draft stack — review and land in this order</summary>

1/n (#5674) is merged. 2/n (#5675) was closed because the validated recipes do not use its prefetch-disable policy; it is no longer in the stack.

| Position | Draft PR |
| --- | --- |
| 3/n | [#5676 — [fsdp] 3/n Support layer-scoped CPU offload](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5676) |
| 4/n | [#5677 — [optim] 4/n Bound optimizer memory ownership and allocation lifetimes](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5677) |
| 5/n | [#5678 — [dist_muon] 5/n Support CP and TP storage-to-compute layouts](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5678) |
| 6/n | [#5679 — [profiler] 6/n Preserve active failures during shutdown](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5679) |
| 7/n | [#5680 — [attention] 7/n Keep linear-attention graph metadata replayable](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5680) |
| 8/n | [#5681 — [cp] 8/n Apply the Ulysses NCCL safeguard to compact and linear attention](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5681) |
| 9/n | [#5682 — [compile] 9/n Compile MLA assembly and router postprocessing](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5682) |
| 10/n | [#5683 — [pp] 10/n Make startup and update-boundary cache release explicit](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5683) |
| 11/n | [#5684 — [dist_moe] 11/n Enable Kimi K3 SiTU-GLU training and pipeline lifecycle](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5684) |
| 12/n | [#5685 — [moe] 12/n Add opt-in shared-expert CUDA stream overlap](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5685) |
| 13/n | [#5686 — [ac] 13/n Add block-scoped activation retention](https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/pull/5686) |
| 14/n | Full-scale 256-GB300 and 512-GB200 MXFP8 recipes; separate draft PR being prepared |

</details>
